label: For "Provider Recredentialing Automation": Orchestrate periodic recredentialing cycles, evidence collection, verification, exception routing and committee packet preparation with a deterministic case state machine and human sign-off for every adverse finding. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Letting the agent finalise a case.
